rule: Run the lowest tier that covers the change class. Tier 3 executes scientific simulations that write results/*.json and runs only inside a TODO that authorizes that execution. After any tier-2 or tier-3 run, `git status --porcelain results/` must be empty or the changes must belong to the authorized lineage.

0.name: harness (seconds)
0.budget: about 30 s; no simulation; writes nothing
0.covers: workspace, JaxFNE identity, manifest schemas, gate definition, drive invariant, estimator/lineage validators, sealed-artifact immutability, verdict semantics, Pages firewall, AGENTS policy

1.name: targeted (cheap)
1.budget: under 2 min; numpy or short JAX; reads sealed results; writes nothing
1.rule: run the tests of the changed subsystem

by_subsystem.unclassified subsystems: classify cost and writes on first use; add here

2.name: compatibility
2.when: a shared scientific surface changes (jomission/ network, simulation, qualification; JaxFNE version)

3.name: scientific execution
3.budget: minutes to hours; V2.1 batteries ~32 GB RSS per process, run serially
3.when: only inside a TODO item whose procedure names the test
3.writes: results/*.json (verdict tests rewrite lineage files even when content is unchanged)

change_class_to_tier.JaxFNE upgrade or environment change: 0 + 1 + 2, then a migration lineage authorizing tier 3 replay of the current gate battery
change_class_to_tier.new scientific execution: 0 + 1 before; the TODO's own tier-3 test; 0 after
